title: Failure recovery
labels: DETERMINISTIC FIXTURE PROVIDER — scripted workers in real processes; no model was run
SYNTHETIC DATA — every request, team, dataset and value is invented
INJECTED FAULTS — a killed worker, a stalled worker, a killed coordinator; each is labeled in the event log
This demonstrates resilience. It is not evidence of general performance.

steps.claim: A killed worker loses ownership and the work is re-leased under a new fencing token
steps.observed: attempt 1 (pid 1053) is "killed"; the task is now on token g1a2

steps.claim: A worker presumed dead cannot overwrite the attempt that replaced it
steps.observed: its lease expired without a heartbeat; it later presented token g1a1 and was rejected (task is accepted)

steps.claim: A new coordinator resumes from persisted state alone
steps.observed: the second coordinator fenced 1 in-flight attempt(s), finished the mission, and exited 0

steps.claim: An orphaned worker is stopped rather than left running
steps.observed: pid 1249 outlived the coordinator that started it and was stopped on recovery

steps.claim: A duplicate delivery changes nothing, and a conflicting one is quarantined
steps.observed: 5 redelivered requests ignored; the repeated command returned the original mission; the conflicting one was refused: "Idempotency key demo-b-submit was reused with a different body"

steps.claim: Revising an upstream contract invalidates exactly what depended on it
steps.observed: delivery.engine.implement: rerun_required; delivery.integrate: downstream_blocked; reliability.knowledge: rerun_required; review.packet: downstream_blocked; delivery.report.implement: rerun_required

steps.claim: A review decision resting on stale evidence cannot be approved by mistake
steps.observed: the pending decision was superseded, its draft withdrawn, and the mission reopened

steps.claim: Only affected work is redone, and the result is verified again
steps.observed: discovery, criteria, plan and decomposition were not rerun; engine and report were rebuilt against contract v2; all 5 criteria pass again at generation 4

steps.claim: State reconciles after all of it
steps.observed: budget tree reconciles; event chain intact; mission review_ready with a fresh decision requested
